### Notes

What could not be inspected directly: the page is a client-rendered SPA, so the served HTML contains only the header. The body and FAQ copy quoted here were read from JetBrains' own served assets (https://www.jetbrains.com/_assets/startups/index.entry.facc76393c645839042a.js plus the en-us message catalogue in https://www.jetbrains.com/_assets/common.32377008276e33346b66.js), not from rendered DOM. The 50% figure is independently corroborated by the meta description present in the served HTML: 'Save up to 50% on professional development and team tools designed for startups.' The three published eligibility requirements are: 'Your company is privately owned.', 'You can provide evidence proving that your company was established within the last five years.', 'Your company has a website or other discoverable online presence.' No funding, revenue or headcount cap is published (the page notes teams of 50+ should look at business solutions, but does not state this as an eligibility bar). No currency amount is published - the benefit is a percentage discount only. Renders no discount or eligibility content to a fetcher, re-confirmed 2026-09-16.
